title: U-Nesting 2D Solve Response
description: Wire response schema for solve_2d (SolveResponse). The 3D response (Pack3DResponse) is structurally similar but uses bins_used instead of sheets_used and each placement carries z and an orientation label.

error.description: Readable refusal text; null on success. Branch on `code`, not on this text.

code.description: Stable reason a request was refused; null on success. `value_not_finite` (a NaN or infinite number, named by `parameter` and `index`) comes from the bindings whose values can hold one -- C# and Python; a JSON request cannot carry one

details.description: The values behind `code` (only the ones the reason has); null on success

placements.description: Instance-level placements for successfully placed geometry instances

total_requested.description: Total number of geometry INSTANCES requested (sum of every geometry's quantity). 'placements' is instance-level while 'unplaced' is deduplicated to unique geometry IDs, so the instance-level unplaced count is total_requested - placements.length. 0 on error responses.

unplaced.description: Deduplicated unique IDs of geometries that could not be fully placed (NOT per-instance)

unplaced_count.description: Instance-level count of geometry instances that could not be placed (total_requested - placements.length), so placements.length + unplaced_count == total_requested. 0 on error responses.

all_placed.description: Whether every requested instance was placed. 'success' only means the solve completed without error, not that all pieces fit. false on error responses.

used_bounding_box.description: Axis-aligned bounding box [width, height] of the placed pieces' footprint, independent of boundary padding. [0, 0] for multi-sheet solves, when nothing was placed, and on error responses.

used_utilization.description: Placed area over the used bounding box's area: how tightly the pieces pack within their own extent (not a fixed-width stock efficiency). 0 when nothing was placed, in multi-sheet solves and on error responses.

stop_reason.description: Why the run stopped: completed (the strategy ran to its own end), optimal (an exact method proved it), target_reached (every piece placed at target_utilization or more), iteration_limit, no_improvement (the search stalled), time_limit (time_limit_ms ran out; the layout is the best found by then) or cancelled. null on a refusal.

Placement.description: Placement of a single geometry instance

instance.description: Instance index (0-based, for geometries with quantity > 1)

sheet_index.description: Index of the sheet/bin this instance is placed on
